title: Groundnut — Disease Management: Tikka, Crown Rot, Stem Rot
content:
MAJOR DISEASES OF GROUNDNUT:

1. TIKKA / EARLY LEAF SPOT (Cercospora arachidicola):
Symptoms: Circular brown spots with yellow halo on leaves. Premature defoliation.
Management: Chlorothalonil 75 WP @ 2g/L at 30 DAS and 45 DAS. Or Tebuconazole 50%+Trifloxystrobin 25% WG @ 0.5g/L. 2-3 sprays at 10-12 day intervals.

2. LATE LEAF SPOT (Cercosporidium personatum):
Symptoms: Dark brown spots without yellow halo. More severe than early leaf spot.
Management: Same as early leaf spot. Start sprays at 30 DAS preventively.

3. CROWN ROT (Aspergillus niger):
Symptoms: Black masses on collar region, seedling death.
Management: Seed treatment with Thiram 3g/kg + Carbendazim 2g/kg. Avoid sowing in wet soil.

4. STEM ROT / WHITE MOLD (Sclerotium rolfsii):
Symptoms: White mycelial growth at stem base, mustard-seed-like sclerotia.
Management: Trichoderma viride @ 4 kg/ha as soil application. Carbendazim 0.1% stem drench.

5. COLLAR ROT (Aspergillus flavus):
Symptoms: Rotting of collar region, pre and post-emergence damping off.
Management: Seed treatment with Bavistin. Avoid excessive soil moisture at sowing.

6. RUST (Puccinia arachidis):
Symptoms: Orange-brown pustules on lower leaf surface.
Management: Hexaconazole 5 EC @ 1 ml/L or Propiconazole 25 EC @ 1 ml/L.

BIOLOGICAL CONTROL:
- Trichoderma viride @ 5g/kg seed treatment.
- Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/kg seed.
- Both can be mixed together for broad-spectrum protection.
